target_aggregation: six statistics per channel feature, or original channels; globals unchanged
r2_policy: raw retained, exact constants undefined; low variance flagged without removing dimensions
summary: equal weight per subject, then equal weight per defined dimension; no pooled R2 used for model selection
scope: regression only; no shuffled/Gaussian controls, layer analysis, causal erasure, closure or encoded status
row_alignment: original order assumed; labels checked where present
